title: Water Damage Mitigation Drying Period and Monitoring Terms
content:
For each Water Damage Mitigation tier the company sets how many equipment days are billable without monitoring support, whether a longer drying period needs a monitoring visit on each extra day, and what a daily moisture monitoring visit costs.

| Tier | Billable drying day cap (calendar days) | Extension needs monitoring | Monitoring visit fee (USD) | Set-day visit not billable | Visits billable per day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | 4 | Yes | $79.50 | Yes | 1 |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | 5 | Yes | $79.50 | Yes | 1 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | 5 | Yes | $84.00 | Yes | 1 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | 6 | Yes | $84.00 | Yes | 1 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | 6 | Yes | $92.25 | Yes | 1 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | 7 | Yes | $92.25 | Yes | 1 |

## Terms as defined
- **Billable drying day cap**: Equipment days billable on a job without monitoring-supported extension, count of calendar days.
- **Extension needs monitoring**: Whether an equipment day beyond the cap is billable only when a monitoring visit is recorded on that same calendar day, boolean.
- **Monitoring visit fee**: Daily moisture monitoring visit fee per visit day beyond the included visits, USD.
- **Set-day visit not billable**: Whether a monitoring visit on the drying start date (the equipment set day, covered by moisture mapping) is not billable, boolean.
- **Visits billable per day**: Maximum monitoring visits billable per job per calendar day, count.

## Points of reading
- The cap rises with the water category and the loss size, from 4 calendar days on Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss to 7 calendar days on Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss.
- Every tier requires a monitoring visit on an extension day, treats the set-day visit as not billable, and bills at most one visit per job per calendar day.
- The monitoring visit fee depends on the water category only: the Standard Loss and Large Loss tiers of one category carry the same fee.
